references.text: Taanak is mentioned as one of the cities in the tribe of Manasseh, the same place referred to in Deborah's song.
Megiddo and Taanak are mentioned together as cities in Canaan that Israel was to conquer.
Describes the same battle against the Canaanite kings under Sisera that Deborah sings about.
The prose account of the victory over Jabin, king of Canaan, which this verse poetically describes.
Taanak and Megiddo are mentioned together as cities in Solomon's administrative district.
Megiddo is mentioned as the place where King Josiah was killed in battle, another significant battle at this location.
Harmagedon (from Hebrew Har Megiddo - Mount of Megiddo) refers to the same geographical area where the end-time battle will take place.
